source: Regresiones r2 M4 / molestia r2 rama B punto 2 (2026-10-08): a keypad's buttons pressed by UI Automation's Invoke instead of keys sent with SendInput. Each character of an expression is the button named by one of these names (compared folded: lower case, no accents), in Spanish and English as the window writes them; «clear» is the button that empties the entry before the expression. Holdout v5 V5E021/V5E029 (2026-10-24): a name may also be the button's AutomationId, the same in every language (the Scientific keypad's xʸ and parentheses); «clearEntry» (CE) is pressed where the Scientific keypad shows it in place of «clear». Banco de uso 2026-11-03 (U14/U15): the classic Calculator (win32calc, Windows Server's own) names its digit buttons with the digit itself («2», as its UI Automation tree showed in the bench's VMs; FlaUI's LegacyCalc finds them so) and its operators «Add», «Subtract», «Multiply», «Divide», «Equals», «Clear», «Clear entry», «Decimal separator». Read by the App's providers (Baxy.Providers.Windows, embedded resource).
